rules.name: recon-legacy-history-01-inventory
rules.sql: SELECT table_name, CASE WHEN table_name REGEXP '^previous_helper_settle_p_and_g' THEN 'previous_settle' WHEN table_name REGEXP '^helper_actual_settle_p_and_g_view_cache' THEN 'actual_cache' WHEN table_name REGEXP '^helper_settle_p_and_g_view_ws_cache' THEN 'ws_cache' WHEN table_name REGEXP '^helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache' THEN 'settle_cache' WHEN table_name REGEXP '^helper_traders_p_and_g_view_cache' THEN 'traders_cache' WHEN table_name REGEXP '^helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view_cache' THEN 'settle_pricing_cache' ELSE 'recon_other' END AS family, table_rows AS est_rows, create_time, update_time FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND table_name REGEXP '^(previous_helper_settle_p_and_g|helper_actual_settle_p_and_g_view_cache|helper_settle_p_and_g_view_ws_cache|helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache|helper_traders_p_and_g_view_cache|helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view_cache|recon)' ORDER BY family, table_name

SELECT CASE WHEN table_name REGEXP '^previous_helper_settle_p_and_g' THEN 'previous_settle' WHEN table_name REGEXP '^helper_actual_settle_p_and_g_view_cache' THEN 'actual_cache' WHEN table_name REGEXP '^helper_settle_p_and_g_view_ws_cache' THEN 'ws_cache' WHEN table_name REGEXP '^helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache' THEN 'settle_cache' WHEN table_name REGEXP '^helper_traders_p_and_g_view_cache' THEN 'traders_cache' WHEN table_name REGEXP '^helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view_cache' THEN 'settle_pricing_cache' ELSE 'recon_other' END AS family, count(*) AS tables, sum(table_rows) AS est_rows, min(update_time) AS oldest_update, max(update_time) AS newest_update FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND table_name REGEXP '^(previous_helper_settle_p_and_g|helper_actual_settle_p_and_g_view_cache|helper_settle_p_and_g_view_ws_cache|helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache|helper_traders_p_and_g_view_cache|helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view_cache|recon)' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
